title: Server State with React Query & SWR

scenes.line1: How do you handle server data?
scenes.say: When your app needs fresh data from a server, do you fetch it every time, or cache it for speed?

scenes.label: React Query
scenes.sub: Handles fetching, caching, and updating remote data.
scenes.say: React Query is a library that handles fetching, caching, and updating remote data for you.
With React Query, you use the useQuery hook to fetch and cache data automatically.
Both React Query and S W R offer caching, but React Query adds refetching and background updates. S W R uses a stale-while-revalidate approach.

scenes.question: Is server state the same as local state?
scenes.right: No. Server state comes from APIs and needs syncing.
scenes.say: Don't confuse server state with local state. Server state comes from remote APIs and needs syncing, while local state lives only in your component.
